name: Notesheet
description: Spreadsheets for Joplin. A Joplin note can be a full spreadsheet powered by the Univer SDK — formulas, formatting, sort, filter, charts, and .xlsx import/export.
author: Kamlesh Nanda

screenshots.label: An imported Excel workbook with a bar chart and a pie chart, anchored to the grid and updating live
A named table with banded rows, hyperlinks, number formats and a totals row
Conditional formatting: color scales, data bars, highlight rules, top-N and icon sets

promo_tile.label: Notesheet: real spreadsheets inside Joplin notes
